text: おれの　ポケモン　レベル　あげても　なかなか　しんか　しないぜえ！

structure.en: even when I raise their levels

structure.jp: なかなか　しんか　しないぜえ！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus も means 'even if' or 'even when'. レベル　あげても = 'even when I raise their levels'.

patterns.name: なかなか〜ない
patterns.span: なかなか　しんか　しない
patterns.explanation: なかなか with a 'not' verb says something just won't happen however long you wait. なかなか　しんか　しない = 'just won't evolve'.
